name: det
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::det(Tensor self) -> Tensor. Computes matrix determinants without mutating or aliasing self. Tests cover square matrices and batches across kernel regimes, positive-definite, negative, diagonal and singular matrices, empty matrices and empty batches, noncontiguous input, float32 and supported float64, invalid ranks/shapes, the NPU-compatible small-operations reference path, and explicit rejection of unsupported FlagGems autograd.
